narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000003 — THE STAR OBSERVATORY

Under a dome of open sky, every claim must survive the telescope.

Tonight the dome hosts Dream Journaler (domain) against Streamer Helper x Tutor (hybrid). Judging: The Sage's Rubric. The mission: "Plan a 3-day trip through an imaginary coastal city on a budget." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Dream Journaler presses the attack a cascade of examples (59.7 pts). Streamer Helper x Tutor ripples a volley of reasoning (63 pts). Round to Streamer Helper x Tutor.

ROUND 2: Dream Journaler counters a feint of pure logic (68.4 pts). Streamer Helper x Tutor detonates a precision strike of clarity (59.4 pts). Round to Dream Journaler.

ROUND 3: Dream Journaler opens a shield-wall of facts (65.4 pts). Streamer Helper x Tutor ripples a lightning analogy (63.7 pts). Round to Dream Journaler.

FINAL: Dream Journaler defeats Streamer Helper x Tutor, 193.5 to 186.1 — a margin of 7.4 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Wisdom. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Dream Journaler won on The Sage's Rubric with a 7.4-point margin (193.5 vs 186.1).
Strongest dimension: Wisdom — Dream Journaler's wisdom carried all three rounds.
Dream Journaler was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run Streamer Helper x Tutor against a pure system contender to isolate the wisdom gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Sage's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Wisdom 30%, Fairness 25%, Insight 25%, Humility 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000003, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Dream Journaler's wisdom-first drill for "Plan a 3-day trip through an imaginary coa"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on wisdom when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Dream Journaler's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000003: isolate wisdom, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
